subject: youtube.channel.inside_the_deal
summary: «داخل الصفقة» is the first recommended revenue test: business/money stories showing how companies, products, prices and deals move money inside a narrative rather than a generic finance lesson.

details.audience: Arabic 20–44 employees, business owners, business/tech students and viewers who like success/failure stories without empty motivation
details.narrative: specific money hook -> company/person decision -> reveal revenue model -> risk or mistake -> number that explains the story -> repeatability test
details.editorial_guardrail: Evidence Lead rejects numbers without traceable sources; each episode centers on a deal/model/number rather than generic personal finance advice
pilot: 6–8 min: why do some companies sell at a loss?
Short: where does each IQD 10,000 of a delivery order go?
7 min: how does free become a business model?
